problem: Live procedural editor objects and CI-owned checkouts can disappear despite a clean code repository.
invariant: Use a single configured authoring checkout, isolate CI, pin external data identities, and verify a saved scene in a fresh editor before declaring a checkpoint recoverable.
failure_behavior: Do not admit stale or failed reopen proof. Preserve originals and distinguish local recovery from remote backup. Avoid duplicating full GPU scenes to create backups.
